parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID list of the resources. You can specify up to 50 IDs in each request.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   dedicatedblockstoragecluster: dedicated block storage cluster
*   diskreplicapair: replication pair
*   diskreplicagroup: replication pair-consistent group

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The resource tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`.
